notes: The entire fixed supply is minted once to the deployer. Transfers from the fixed Ethereum Uniswap v4 PoolManager pay 2% to the fixed treasury; all transfers to the PoolManager and wallet transfers are untaxed. The launch factory handles the external 10% swarm allocation, 90% pool seeding and 1% platform fee. Pool fee is 1.25%. initialPrice is provenance only; the launch derives the opening price from economics and deployed currency order. No owner, admin, further minting or upgradeability.
